Jesus so the nations could be glad and sing for joy. That is why the writer to
Hebrews says it was for the joy set before him that Jesus endured the cross.
For you and I, that means that we don't need the vanity of chasing the American dream
or the empty promises of the prosperity gospel.
We get the greater blessing of following our Savior in laying down our lives for the good
of those around us.
We can pour our lives out for the good of the nations.
We can give what we cannot keep to gain what we can never lose.
We can abandon small dreams and share the good news of the gospel.
We can remember, as David Livingston said it, that God had only one son,
and he was a missionary.
May we follow Him in mission here in Portland and to the ends of the earth.
Father, we do ask that the peoples would praise You, that all the peoples would praise You.
I pray that You would take this church and continue to use it as a light in the city of Portland and to the ends of the earth.
We pray in Jesus' name. Amen.
